_comment: App sandbox (docs/os-plan.md). system_apps start without a sandbox, like Finder and Terminal on a Mac. apps: what a sandboxed app needs beyond the automatic rules – data: its own folders in the home folder, args: extra start arguments, devices: device files it needs (e.g. /dev/kvm for Claude's Cowork VM), dbus_own: D-Bus names it owns and talks to (e.g. to hand a link to its running window), ro: folders it may only read (its program, when it comes from a release archive: archive-apps.json), env: environment it needs. Entries of one package that run the same program become one app by themselves; part_of {entry: {app?, name?}} names a part (or adds one not found), separate [entries] keeps entries apps of their own.
